name: cloudcost
description: Multi-tenant AWS cost visibility SaaS — weekly spend by project, trends, anomaly flags and email digests.

scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @cloudcost/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @cloudcost/api" "npm run dev -w @cloudcost/web"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis mailpit
